rows.title: AGENTS.md — dragonfly-mobile
rows.summary: The mobile platform of Dragonfly: apps for Android, iOS and the web written in Nuclear.
body: The mobile platform of Dragonfly: apps for Android, iOS and the web written in Nuclear. Its dialect `flutter` (TOML + templates read by the `nuclear` compiler) and its Dart runtime, the `dragonfly` package (repositories over dio, state managers, events, sessions, ACL, routing, forms, a local database), plus `dragonfly_genkit` for AI.
This repository is a folder of the NuclearLang working tree (`nuclear/dragonfly-mobile`); the platform's rules are the
working tree's `../AGENTS.md` ([nuclear](https://github.com/nuclearlang/nuclear/blob/main/AGENTS.md)) and its state is `../STATUS.md`.
- Context of this repository: [docs/context/dragonfly-mobile/CONTEXT.md](docs/context/dragonfly-mobile/CONTEXT.md).

- What is inside: `dialects/mobile/` (the platform contract and the `flutter` dialect), `packages/{dragonfly,dragonfly_genkit}` (the Dart runtimes), `defs/dart/` (type definitions of Flutter and the packages), `spec/{mobile,flutter,dragonfly}.md`, `examples/`, `docs/`.
- Checks:
```sh
(cd .. && cargo test)                                  # builds the examples, compares the goldens
python3 tools/spec-check-dragonfly.py                  # the spec's 27 examples
(cd packages/dragonfly && flutter test && flutter analyze)
(cd examples/examples-flutter-dialect/tasks_app && dragonfly build && dragonfly test)

body: - First public version.
- `[[generators]]` in the platform: `dragonfly gen` writes a resource's models, repository, use cases, screen with its state manager and tests (ADR-0103).
- `[[generators.usecase]]`: `dragonfly gen usecase` adds a use case's alias to its component's facade and, with `--calls`, writes a use case over a repository method (ADR-0103).
- `[[generators.resource]]`: the repository is merged (`merge = true`), so an action added to a resource that exists gets the members it lacks (ADR-0105).

rows.title: Dragonfly for mobile — the platform and its dialect `flutter`
rows.summary: Future repository `dragonfly-mobile` (ADR-0093 amends ADR-0083).
body: Future repository `dragonfly-mobile` (ADR-0093 amends ADR-0083). The platform (`spec/mobile.md`, Nuclear only) is what the
user writes; `flutter` is its only dialect today (`react-native`, `kotlin-multiplatform` planned). Three parts (ADR-0039,
- the **`flutter` dialect** (`dialects/mobile/flutter/`): kinds and decorators that transpile Nuclear to Dart and add
behaviour (a `repository` with `@get` writes the http call, the mapping and the cache);
- the **Dart package `dragonfly`** (`packages/dragonfly/`): what Flutter lacks (http with cache and retries,
the local database, events, session, ACL, network, routes, logs, forms, dialogs, translations, splash, test helpers).
Independent and publishable (MIT, README/CHANGELOG, `example/`; `repository` missing in the pubspec);

- the CLI and editor extensions, documented in [cli](https://github.com/nuclearlang/dragonfly/blob/main/docs/context/cli/CONTEXT.md) and [editors](https://github.com/nuclearlang/nuclear/blob/main/docs/context/editors/CONTEXT.md).

rows.title: Dragonfly for mobile — the platform and its dialect `flutter` — Rules of this area
rows.summary: sites); Flutter specifics never do.
body: - Language rules come from the base; this dialect adds kinds and decorators only as data in `dialects/mobile/flutter`.
- Generic mechanisms belong in Rust (projects, `decor`, `[decorators.args]`, `[architecture.names]`, call
sites); Flutter specifics never do.
- The package must work on web: no `dart:isolate`/`dart:io` without `kIsWeb` guards.
- Project blocks of `spec/flutter.md` are regenerated with `tools/spec-check/dragonfly.py --fix` and checked
by `dragonfly_spec_shows_the_real_output`.
- Roles the user asked for: Flutter architect, Flutter/native optimizer, transpiler architect, framework architect.

rows.title: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
rows.summary: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
body: | `repository` | `@repository(path, connection, saveLocal)`; methods `@get/@post/@put/@patch/@delete(path, headers = {...}, cache, cacheKey, ttl, retry, local)`. A cached method generates `purge<Method>()`; `purgeCache(key)` always exists. Undecorated params: to the path if `:name`, else query (GET/DELETE) or body (POST/PUT/PATCH); `@path`, `@query`, `@body` force it. Automatic retries only on GET, PUT and DELETE. `saveLocal = true` / `@get(local = true)` (ADR-0096): a GET whose `ret_info.model` has `fields_decor.primary` (or `generated`) and no type args gets `local: 'Repo.method'` in `send` and a `<method>AsLocal()` twin (`recall`), both in `repository_method.tpl` under `{{#deco_args.local or owner_decor.repository.saveLocal}}`; the generated tests call the twin. A method with a body queries `local<M>()` (plain Dart method) |
| `usecase` | one method `exec`, always returns `Result`; guards `@requires(internet, session)` and `@acl(roles, permissions, guards)` |
| `appcomponent` | the facade: exposes the component's functions, usually aliases `getOne() = GetOneCharacterUseCase.exec` |
| `service`, `aggregate` | helpers of use cases |
| `statemodel` | each field is a state (a `bool` is a state without data); `initial` always exists; generates a typed `<Model>Builder<Manager>` |

rows.title: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
rows.summary: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
body: | `statemanager` | a screen's Cubit: `@stateModel(M)`, `@state(M.field)` emits that state, `@before(f)`/`@after(f)`; a `@state` returning `Result` emits the error with the `Err` |

| `stateless` / `stateful` + `@screen` | `@screen(route, providers, loggedIn = { forward }, acl = { roles, permissions, guards, forward }, shell = { widget, tab }, notFound, transition = ScreenTransition.x)` (ADR-0055, 0085). `@splash(color!, image)` → native splash (ADR-0063) |
| `event` | typed global event (`shared/events/`) with `fromJson`/`toJson` and `eventName` (JSON fields only) |
| `component` | global component (`shared/components/`, ADR-0053): anyone uses it; its `@on(Event)` methods always receive |
| `guard` | `canActivate()` with injected dependencies, like NestJS; sync or async (`~`) |

| `form` / `formmanager` | form model with `@required @email @url @minLength @maxLength @min @max @pattern @matches` (with `message`); `@form(F)`, `@validate("field")` = remote validation with debounce (ADR-0058) |

| `tests` / `integration` | `@mock([X])` (mocktail), `@test`, `@states` (bloc_test), `@widget`, `@offline`; without decorator = setUp/tearDown; `X.m()` = `inject<X>().m()`; Result does not propagate (ADR-0049) |

rows.title: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
rows.summary: returns (ADR-0048).
body: - `Result<E, T>` is error first (Dart: fpdart `Either`, ADR-0047); `.ok()`/`.error()` by what the callback
returns (ADR-0048).
- Navigation `context.goTo/pushTo/goBack(Screen(...))`, only in views.
- Generated: `lib/dragonfly.g.dart`, `test/dragonfly_generated_test.dart` (JSON of models, repository
contracts, route guards, smoke), `flutter_native_splash.yaml` (only with `decorated.splash`). Generated tests
ask the converter for a field's JSON: `const Conv().toJson(DateTime(2000))`, or `sample()` when it has one;
an enum field gets `Enum.values.first.name`.
- Examples: `shared/models/page.nuc` (`Page<T>`, `PageInfo`), `episode.nuc` +
`shared/converters/date_converter.nuc`, `shared/screens/start_screen.nuc` (the `@splash`, route `/start`,
initial route).
- Every kind and decorator has its entry in `dialects/mobile/flutter/docs.toml` (ADR-0079).

rows.title: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
rows.summary: Kinds and decorators (`spec/flutter.md` §6)
body: | Kind | Rule |
| `appConfig` / `config` | global / per-component configuration: `Http(connectionName, baseUrl, timeouts, interceptors)`, `WebSocket(uri, connectionName, interceptors)`, global services; `logColor` |

| `model` | only the definition; the transpiler writes the immutable class, `fromJson`/`toJson` (json_serializable) and equality. Generics `Page<T>` (ADR-0062, `genericArgumentFactories`). `@key("json_name")`; `@Converter` on a field (ADR-0064). `@primary` (`@primary(generated = true)`: the table gives the key; + `@created`, `@updated`) give it a local table named by `@entity("table")` (`decor.entity.arg`, default snake_case): `static final LocalTable<M> table`, registered with its component in `registerDragonfly` (ADR-0096; `field_decor` in `model.tpl` and the project context) |
| `converter` | `fromJson(json: J) T` + `toJson(value: T) J` (+ optional `sample() T` for generated tests) → `JsonConverter<T, J>`; in `shared/converters/`, visible everywhere |

rows.title: Dragonfly project (`spec/flutter.md` §3) — Architecture rules (the linter, ADR-0046; `spec/projects.md` §4)
rows.summary: The transpiler checks the dialect's `[architecture]` across the whole project; all are errors; the editor shows them.
body: The transpiler checks the dialect's `[architecture]` across the whole project; all are errors; the editor
shows them. Who calls whom (N0301): usecase ← appcomponent; service ← usecase or aggregate; aggregate ← usecase;
repository ← usecase or aggregate; `BuildContext`/`GoRouter`/`appRouter` only in views
(`[architecture.names]`). Closed components (N0302): visible from another component are the appcomponent,
models, converters, events, global components, guards and screens. Tests may use everything. One injector
(GetIt); privacy is checked by the transpiler, not the runtime. Open questions (warnings, disabling per file,
new rules) are in `STATUS.md`.

rows.title: Dragonfly project (`spec/flutter.md` §3) — Assets by convention (ADR-0071, `spec/flutter.md` §3.2)
rows.summary: No assets section: `assets/fonts/<Family>/<Family>-BoldItalic.ttf` → `fonts:` (weight and style from the name; `Oblique` = italic; two equal files are an error), `assets/shaders/*.frag` → `shaders:`, any other folder → `assets:`; rewritten on every build.
body: No assets section: `assets/fonts/<Family>/<Family>-BoldItalic.ttf` → `fonts:` (weight and style from the name;
`Oblique` = italic; two equal files are an error), `assets/shaders/*.frag` → `shaders:`, any other folder →
`assets:`; rewritten on every build. No `dependency_overrides`: the project only adds.

rows.title: Dragonfly project (`spec/flutter.md` §3) — config.nuc (ADR-0065, 0066, 0069, 0070; `spec/flutter.md` §3.1)
rows.summary: The project's pubspec in Nuclear: `app(name, description, version, usesMaterialDesign)`, `environment(sdk, flutter)`, `dependencies(package = "version")`, `devDependencies(...)`.
body: The project's pubspec in Nuclear: `app(name, description, version, usesMaterialDesign)`, `environment(sdk,
flutter)`, `dependencies(package = "version")`, `devDependencies(...)`. An empty section is not written. Not
transpiled; errors are N0303. Only third-party packages the framework does not use: Dragonfly's own
(dragonfly, flutter_bloc, fpdart, go_router, json_annotation, build_runner, json_serializable, mocktail,
bloc_test, integration_test, flutter_native_splash) are added automatically and visible in
`build/app/pubspec.yaml`; listing one is N0303 on its line and `dragonfly flutter add` rejects it. A project
without `config.nuc` gets one on its first `check`/`build`.

rows.title: Dragonfly project (`spec/flutter.md` §3) — Definitions of project packages
rows.summary: Each dependency gets type definitions generated once into `~/.cache/nuclearlang/defs` and listed in `build/defs.lock` (imports, overrides, hover).
body: Each dependency gets type definitions generated once into `~/.cache/nuclearlang/defs` and listed in
`build/defs.lock` (imports, overrides, hover). Debugging a name of a package without an import: look at
`build/defs.lock` and the cache (`nuclear defs show` does not see them). The editor uses the same lock.

rows.title: Dragonfly project (`spec/flutter.md` §3)
rows.summary: generated goes to `build/` (the app in `build/app`) and is never edited.
body: - **Only `.nuc` files and `assets/`** (ADR-0050). No `nuclear.toml`; the project name is the folder. Everything
generated goes to `build/` (the app in `build/app`) and is never edited.
- Layout: `main.nuc`, `config.nuc`, `config/` (appConfig), `shared/` (`widgets events models converters
components guards screens`), `components/<c>/` (facade `<c>_component.nuc`, `config/`, `data/`,
`domain/{models, usecases, aggregates, services}`, `presentation/<screen>/{managers, state_models, forms}`,
`presentation/widgets`), `assets/i18n/<locale>/`, `assets/splash/`, `test/`, `integration_test/`.
- Kind by folder: a declaration without a header word in `models/`, `state_models/`, `forms/`, `test/` or
`integration_test/` takes its folder's kind. What is in `test/` is only visible to files in `test/`.

rows.title: The `dragonfly` Dart package (`spec/dragonfly.md`)
rows.summary: `(cd packages/dragonfly && flutter test && flutter analyze)` — 64 tests.
body: `(cd packages/dragonfly && flutter test && flutter analyze)` — 64 tests. `Global.init/dispose`.
- **Local database** (ADR-0096, `src/local/local.dart`, `spec/dragonfly.md` §3.2): `Local` (hive_ce boxes, the same on
every platform; `LocalDatabase(encrypted)` from the configs' `local`, per component (`configure`/`settings`, the
table's `component`), AES key in the secure storage made at the first encrypted box, `memory` for tests,
`store`/`recall` with the calls box), `LocalTable<T>` (CRUD + the
backend's query builder over JSON rows; `putRow` stamps `created`/`updated` and gives `generated` keys),
`LocalQuery<T>`, the operators `gt`...`between` (no `isNull`: it clashes with the `flutter_test` matcher; a plain
`null` in `where`), `NotFound` (a `RepositoryError`, like `HttpError`; `attempt` catches both). `Repository.send(local:)`,
`recall`, `target`, `local<T>()`, `saveLocal`. `Dragonfly.reset` closes it; `DragonflyTest.start` sets `memory`.

rows.title: The `dragonfly` Dart package (`spec/dragonfly.md`)
rows.summary: hidden ones, the last of each type when shown again.
body: - **Events** (ADR-0052): `Events.publish/subscribe`. On demand: the visible screen gets the event at once;
hidden ones, the last of each type when shown again. `component` with `@on` always receive. A background
isolate publishes to the main one (not on web: no `ReceivePort`/`IsolateNameServer` with `kIsWeb`); an
`event` has `eventName` + `toJson`/`fromJson`, so from another engine (workmanager) it travels as JSON text
and `Events.decoder` (registered in `registerModels`) reads it back. The
backend publishes with header `x-app-event` (`EventInterceptor`). Widgets `EventBuilder`, `EventListener`,
`GlobalEvents<T>`, mixin `EventsOnDemand`.
- **Session** (ADR-0054): `session.start(data, token, roles, permissions, expiresAt)`, `get<T>()`,
`set/value/remove`, `destroy()`; flutter_secure_storage, survives restarts. `start` publishes
`SessionStarted<T>`, `destroy` publishes `SessionEnded` and purges the cache. `SessionInterceptor` adds the
token, ends the session on a 401 and never sends an expired token.
- **ACL** (ADR-0056): Phalcon style (`Acl(inherits, permissions)`, deny by default) + NestJS guards. The access
map per screen is computed once per session. `Guard`/`Guards`. `canActivate` is `FutureOr<bool>`: the
router (async `redirect` only then), `AclBuilder`, `Acl.check` and `Guards.verify` (async use cases) wait;

No third-party libraries.

rows.title: The `dragonfly` Dart package (`spec/dragonfly.md`)
rows.summary: `Acl.can`/`canOpen`/`Guards.check` stay sync and throw on an async guard.
body: `Acl.can`/`canOpen`/`Guards.check` stay sync and throw on an async guard.
- **Routes** (ADR-0057): go_router from views only; `AppRoute`, `goTo/pushTo/goBack`, typed path and query
parameters, deep links, `shell` tabs, `notFound`, `ScreenTransition` per screen; routes nested by path
prefix (back returns to the parent).
- **Network**: `NetworkManager` (connection and quality; probes only when connectivity changes; on web trusts
the browser), `NetworkManager.fixed`, `NetworkWrapper`, `NetworkBuilder`.
- **Http**: `Repository.send/attempt`, in-memory cache with TTL and cap (`MemoryCache(maxEntries = 256)`),
retry with growing waits, interceptors `HttpLogInterceptor`, `SessionInterceptor`, `EventInterceptor`.
`WebSocket` uses `dart:io` (does not work on web).
- **Logs** (ADR-0078, `spec/flutter.md` §6.17, `lib/src/log/log.dart`): `Log.d/i/s/w/e` (+ long names); one
block per log with breadcrumb `component › kind › Class.method`, time, message, `data` as JSON, error, stack
and the `.nuc:line` at the foot (written by the transpiler, `at`). Thick frame and level badge in Bootstrap

rows.title: Security and performance rules
rows.summary: Dragonfly must warn when code breaks one of these.
body: Dragonfly must warn when code breaks one of these.
| Topic | Rule |
| Headers | name/value pairs: `headers = { "Accept": "application/json" }` |
| Retries | automatic only on idempotent methods; POST/PATCH only with an explicit `retry` |
| Cache | purged when the session ends |
| WebSocket | `wss://` in production (`ws://` travels unencrypted) |
| Tokens | only SessionManager stores them (secure storage); never in annotations or config |
| Logs | mask sensitive data; no debug/info in release |
| Network | no constant polling: only on connectivity changes and on demand |
| Events | typed (kind `event`), delivered on demand |
